{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzmZTpQhEp5DAMSMQSdq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JAM69PZWDeYJosn5duJuGt","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r4/matmul/matmul.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\n// Half-open range of matrix rows [begin, end)\nstruct RowRange {\n    size_t begin;\n    size_t end;\n};\n\n// Block distribution of N rows over `size` ranks\nRowRange rowRange(const size_t N, const int rank, const int size) noexcept {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    return {N * r / p, N * (r + 1) / p};\n}\n\n// Fill rows [rows.begin, rows.end) of an N x N matrix. `mat` holds only those rows.\nvoid initRows(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const RowRange rows) {\n    for (size_t i = rows.begin; i < rows.end; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rows.begin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C = A * B for the locally owned rows. A and C hold `localRows` rows, B is the full N x N matrix.\n// The loops are tiled and ordered i-k-j for cache reuse and vectorization. Each C(i,j) still\n// accumulates its k-terms in ascending order, so results are bit-identical to the naive product.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t localRows) {\n    constexpr size_t KB = 128;\n    constexpr size_t JB = 256;\n\n    std::fill(C.begin(), C.end(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < N; jj += JB) {\n        const size_t jEnd = std::min(jj + JB, N);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < N; kk += KB) {\n            const size_t kEnd = std::min(kk + KB, N);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < localRows; ++i) {\n                double* c = &C[i * N];\n                for (size_t k = kk; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n                    const double a = A[i * N + k];\n                    const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                    for (size_t j = jj; j < jEnd; ++j) {\n                        c[j] += a * b[j];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\n// A(i,k) is identical to getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k), so it is recomputed here instead of stored.\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. B is replicated on every rank.\n    const RowRange rows = rowRange(N, rank, size);\n    const size_t localRows = rows.end - rows.begin;\n\n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<double> A(localRows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(localRows * N);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (deterministic, so every rank derives the same values it needs)\n    if (root) printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initRows(A, N, rows);\n    initRows(B, N, RowRange{0, N});\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N, localRows);\n\n    const double localSeconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double seconds = 0.0;\n    // The parallel run takes as long as its slowest rank\n    MPI_Reduce(&localSeconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(seconds * 1000.0));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full C on the root only when it is needed for output or validation\n    const bool needFullC = printResults || validate;\n    std::vector<double> Cfull;\n    if (needFullC) {\n        // Row-typed transfers keep counts in rows, so N*N may exceed INT_MAX\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(N), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n        std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const RowRange rr = rowRange(N, r, size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.end - rr.begin);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.begin);\n        }\n\n        if (root) Cfull.resize(N * N);\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), rowType,\n                    Cfull.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(Cfull, \"MatrixC\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(B, Cfull, N);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                return 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":10417,"cache_read_input_tokens":17869,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":10417},"output_tokens":9,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9a59cd7f-eb3d-46f8-9c59-622ea68ad50d","uuid":"032cc083-9da0-4f90-971a-9fcd81b0e439","timestamp":"2026-10-13T19:13:48.028Z","request_id":"req_011CfzmZSz43nzzWowyXHBjf"}

A and C hold `localRows` rows, B is the full N x N matrix.\n// The loops are tiled and ordered i-k-j for cache reuse and vectorization. Each C(i,j) still\n// accumulates its k-terms in ascending order, so results are bit-identical to the naive product.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t localRows) {\n    constexpr size_t KB = 128;\n    constexpr size_t JB = 256;\n\n    std::fill(C.begin(), C.end(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < N; jj += JB) {\n        const size_t jEnd = std::min(jj + JB, N);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < N; kk += KB) {\n            const size_t kEnd = std::min(kk + KB, N);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < localRows; ++i) {\n                double* c = &C[i * N];\n                for (size_t k = kk; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n                    const double a = A[i * N + k];\n                    const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                    for (size_t j = jj; j < jEnd; ++j) {\n                        c[j] += a * b[j];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\n// A(i,k) is identical to getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k), so it is recomputed here instead of stored.\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. B is replicated on every rank.\n    const RowRange rows = rowRange(N, rank, size);\n    const size_t localRows = rows.end - rows.begin;\n\n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<double> A(localRows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(localRows * N);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (deterministic, so every rank derives the same values it needs)\n    if (root) printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initRows(A, N, rows);\n    initRows(B, N, RowRange{0, N});\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N, localRows);\n\n    const double localSeconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double seconds = 0.0;\n    // The parallel run takes as long as its slowest rank\n    MPI_Reduce(&localSeconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(seconds * 1000.0));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full C on the root only when it is needed for output or validation\n    const bool needFullC = printResults || validate;\n    std::vector<double> Cfull;\n    if (needFullC) {\n        // Row-typed transfers keep counts in rows, so N*N may exceed INT_MAX\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(N), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n        std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const RowRange rr = rowRange(N, r, size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.end - rr.begin);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.begin);\n        }\n\n        if (root) Cfull.resize(N * N);\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), rowType,\n                    Cfull.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(Cfull, \"MatrixC\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(B, Cfull, N);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                return 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":133,"oldLines":7,"newStart":133,"newLines":6,"lines":["         printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");","         printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);","         printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");","-        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);","     }"," ","     // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. r < size; ++r) {\n            const RowRange rr = rowRange(N, r, size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.end - rr.begin);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.begin);\n        }\n\n        if (root) Cfull.resize(N * N);\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), rowType,\n                    Cfull.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(Cfull, \"MatrixC\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(B, Cfull, N);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                return 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":222,"oldLines":7,"newStart":222,"newLines":9,"lines":["     MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);","     MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);"," ","-    const int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);","+    int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);","+    // Every rank exits with the root's status, e.g. when validation fails on the root","+    MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);"," ","     MPI_Finalize();","     return status;"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_016LKYkT14AYKk2hD3o2G3eK","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. j < jEnd; ++j) {\n                        c[j] += a * b[j];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}","originalFile":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\n// Half-open range of matrix rows [begin, end)\nstruct RowRange {\n    size_t begin;\n    size_t end;\n};\n\n// Block distribution of N rows over `size` ranks\nRowRange rowRange(const size_t N, const int rank, const int size) noexcept {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    return {N * r / p, N * (r + 1) / p};\n}\n\n// Fill rows [rows.begin, rows.end) of an N x N matrix. `mat` holds only those rows.\nvoid initRows(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const RowRange rows) {\n    for (size_t i = rows.begin; i < rows.end; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rows.begin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C = A * B for the locally owned rows. A and C hold `localRows` rows, B is the full N x N matrix.\n// Register-blocked: each MR x NR tile of C is accumulated in registers across all k. Every C(i,j)\n// still sums its k-terms in ascending order, so results are bit-identical to the naive product.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t localRows) {\n    constexpr size_t MR = 4;\n    constexpr size_t NR = 8;\n\n    for (size_t i0 = 0; i0 < localRows; i0 += MR) {\n        const size_t mr = std::min(MR, localRows - i0);\n        for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < N; j0 += NR) {\n            const size_t nr = std::min(NR, N - j0);\n\n            double acc[MR][NR] = {};\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                const double* b = &B[k * N + j0];\n                for (size_t r = 0; r < mr; ++r) {\n                    const double a = A[(i0 + r) * N + k];\n                    for (size_t c = 0; c < nr; ++c) {\n                        acc[r][c] += a * b[c];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < mr; ++r) {\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < nr; ++c) {\n                    C[(i0 + r) * N + j0 + c] = acc[r][c];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\n// A(i,k) is identical to getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k), so it is recomputed here instead of stored.\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. B is replicated on every rank.\n    const RowRange rows = rowRange(N, rank, size);\n    const size_t localRows = rows.end - rows.begin;\n\n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<double> A(localRows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(localRows * N);\n\n    // Initialize matrices (deterministic, so every rank derives the same values it needs)\n    if (root) printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initRows(A, N, rows);\n    initRows(B, N, RowRange{0, N});\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N, localRows);\n\n    const double localSeconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double seconds = 0.0;\n    // The parallel run takes as long as its slowest rank\n    MPI_Reduce(&localSeconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(seconds * 1000.0));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full C on the root only when it is needed for output or validation\n    const bool needFullC = printResults || validate;\n    std::vector<double> Cfull;\n    if (needFullC) {\n        // Row-typed transfers keep counts in rows, so N*N may exceed INT_MAX\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(N), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n        std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const RowRange rr = rowRange(N, r, size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.end - rr.begin);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.begin);\n        }\n\n        if (root) Cfull.resize(N * N);\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), rowType,\n                    Cfull.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(Cfull, \"MatrixC\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(B, Cfull, N);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                return 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, rank, size);\n    // Every rank exits with the root's status, e.g. when validation fails on the root\n    MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":37,"oldLines":34,"newStart":37,"newLines":28,"lines":[" }"," "," // C = A * B for the locally owned rows. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfznh7X791KbwvRP262b4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The matmul benchmark now always runs under MPI. Its results match the original bit for bit, and it scales close to linearly with rank count. The executable is still `matmul`, and I only edited `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt`.\n\n**Verification**\n- **Correctness:** I checked the result hash, sum, min/max, and samples against a reference build across 12 sizes (N = 1 to 777) and 6 rank counts (1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 16). All 72 runs matched and passed validation.\n- **Scaling (N=2048):** 5.2 GFLOPS on 1 rank, 9.9 on 2, 21.0 on 4, and 41.5 on 8. The original binary took 98.9 s at this size, about 0.17 GFLOPS.\n- **Build:** clean with `-Wall -Wextra`. The CMake build was done in `/tmp`, so nothing new was created in the project.\n\n**Choices I made**\n- **Decomposition:** rows of A and C are block-distributed across ranks. Every rank generates all of B locally, since the initialization is deterministic, so no broadcast is needed. The only communication is a `MPI_Gatherv` of C to rank 0, and it runs only with `-r` or `-v`. Timing covers the barrier-synchronized multiply, and it reports the slowest rank.\n- **Bit-exact results:** each element still sums its k-terms in ascending order. I added `-ffp-contract=off` to the compile flags. Without it, GCC fused some multiply-adds, and the `-r` hash changed in the last bits. The flag costs about 1% in speed.\n- **Output and exit status:** only rank 0 prints. Rank 0's exit status is broadcast so all ranks agree, including on validation failure.\n- **Validation:** `validateResult` recomputes A's values from the same generator function instead of storing A, which is equivalent.\n\n**Things to know**\n- The output is not identical to the original binary as built with default flags. The original fuses some multiply-adds, and the new build does not, so last-bit differences are expected. The new build matches a reference compiled with the same `-ffp-contract=off` flag.\n- The timing is now wall time, not integer milliseconds, so GFLOPS is computed from precise seconds. The printed time is still truncated to whole milliseconds, as before.\n- I added `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and linked `MPI::MPI_CXX`, so the build fails if MPI is missing. This is what makes the MPI path unconditional.\n- I tried a register-tiled micro-kernel and reverted it. It was slower (3.3 vs 5.0 GFLOPS at N=2048) because the runtime tile bounds kept the accumulators in memory.\n\nI did not commit anything, since this directory is not a git repository."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":734,"cache_read_input_tokens":55792,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":734},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9a59cd7f-eb3d-46f8-9c59-622ea68ad50d","uuid":"a05d557e-1f2f-4404-bcd2-a2f600aa6c85","timestamp":"2026-10-13T19:28:32.948Z","request_id":"req_011Cfznh7D16RhqG3qu2ntNX"}
